# B-roll stat callout over a synthetic presenter

The broll-stat-callout recipe: a brand-coloured bubble with one number and a short label in the upper right, pointing at the speaker, to back up a spoken line.

- Type: B-roll stat callout
- Skill: `magnifito-broll`
- Engine: `hyperframes`
- Output: 1920x1080, 6 s, with audio
- Video: [`../videos/s12-broll-stat-callout.mp4`](../videos/s12-broll-stat-callout.mp4)
- Footage: synthetic, generated by the commands below. No camera footage is used.

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> I have a talking-head clip (synthetic here: make it with node make-footage.mjs, presenter left of centre). While she talks about planning, add a stat callout in the broll-stat-callout style for 4 seconds: "12 planned posts a month", marked as an illustrative example and recorded in claims.json. Upper right, pointing towards her. Render it transparent and lay it over the footage. Brand: brown bubble #7a584c, cream text, green #8acf31 accent, Geist from fonts/.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- s12-broll-stat-callout
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/s12-broll-stat-callout/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
node make-footage.mjs 6 820 left
mgvideo render . --codec mov_prores --force
node collect-run.mjs runs work/overlay.mov
ffmpeg -i work/source.mp4 -itsoffset 1.0 -i work/overlay.mov -filter_complex "[0:v][1:v]overlay=eof_action=pass:format=auto,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -map 0:a -t 6 -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium -c:a aac -b:a 160k work/broll-stat-callout.mp4
```

The finished file is `work/broll-stat-callout.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
